title: FLA import: CPicText instance colorEffect hardcoded null
description: In packages/core/src/fla/flash8-binary.ts readCPicText (line 2374-2377), the colorEffect field is hardcoded to null with a comment that the byte layout is unconfirmed. Compare the CPicText layout against other CPicObj types (CPicSymbol, CPicBitmap) to determine if the colorEffect bytes are in the same position. If confirmed, decode colorEffect for CPicText the same way as for other object types. Note: a fixture FLA with a tinted text field would confirm this, but the byte layout should be derivable from flacomdoc.
